dataset.title: Global Matrisome changes in the obese lung are linked to fibroblastic stroma and premature aging

findings.message: 0.42% of 1% target peptides contain C (whole proteomes: 12-26%); check the alkylant (aging PXR-A37)

36 of the 108 channels of the search's TmtDesign.txt have no row of the SDRF naming their file and label, so their assays sit on the design's own sample (its `Sample Name`), with nothing known about it. E.g. `PXD064681:221102_P-470-VL_038:TMT126`, `PXD064681:221102_P-470-VL_038:TMT127C`, `PXD064681:221102_P-470-VL_038:TMT127N` and 105 more.
The search identified an unusually small fraction of the MS2 spectra. Treat absence of a protein in this dataset as weak evidence. Producer's note: 28773/213369 = 13.49% of MS2 identified (S3)

Some modifications on peptides shared between proteins were not written to ptm_sites for one or more of those proteins, because the peptide could not be located in that protein's sequence and the producer's residue spans cannot be paired with its accessions. Of the (PSM, protein) pairs affected: 118 named a protein that does not contain the stored peptide -- typically a PSM ambiguous between peptide sequences (level 4 or 5), where this protein carries a different candidate than the first, which is the one stored. Sites on the other proteins of the same PSMs are written. Counts are in bundle.json under protein_databases.

10 modification(s) could not be mapped to a UNIMOD accession or a mass, and are carried in ProForma as [Info:...] tags: UniProt:(3S)-3-hydroxyasparagine on N, UniProt:(3S)-3-hydroxyhistidine on H, UniProt:3'-nitrotyrosine on Y, UniProt:5-glutamyl histamine on Q, UniProt:5-glutamyl serotonin on Q, UniProt:N6-crotonyllysine on K, UniProt:N6-malonyllysine on K, UniProt:N6-succinyllysine on K, UniProt:Omega-hydroxyceramide glutamate ester on Q, UniProt:S-(15-deoxy-Delta12,14-prostaglandin J2-9-yl)cysteine on C. Their ptm_sites rows exist and carry modification_name, with modification null, so a query by name finds them and a query by UNIMOD accession will not.

36 channel(s) of the search's TmtDesign.txt are not study samples: `Sample Type` empty: `PXD064681:221102_P-470-VL_038:TMT126`, `PXD064681:221102_P-470-VL_038:TMT127C`, `PXD064681:221102_P-470-VL_038:TMT127N`, `PXD064681:221102_P-470-VL_038:TMT128N`, `PXD064681:221102_P-470-VL_038:TMT134C` and 31 more. Their values measure that reference, not a sample of the question. The design is copied in `sources/`.

PTM site occupancy was not stored: this is a TMT dataset, and MetaMorpheus computes intensity occupancy for label-free searches only; its count occupancy is per file, repeated on every channel (QuantProject DEF-OCC-INT). `ptm_stoichiometry` has no rows here because of that, not because no site was modified.

dataset.summary: PXD064681 is a DDA isobaric dataset (Mus musculus) with 6 runs, 48 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.14. At 1% FDR the search reports 28,773 PSMs, 14,042 peptidoforms and 2,666 protein groups, and the repository holds 31,332 PTM sites for it. 6 open warnings about it are recorded.

organisms_are: `organisms` is the organism of the protein DATABASE the search used, not a statement about the samples. Sample annotation, where any exists, is in the catalog's `samples` and `sample_characteristics` tables.
